name: Surfer Pack
author: IdentityOS
description: Comet-style web agency pack. Gives an identity real browser control: search, judge whether hits help the task, open pages, click/type/login, and continue working inside authenticated sessions.

capabilities.reason: Persistent Chromium session for person-like surfing, login, and in-page actions
Fast HTTP fetch/extract when a full browser is unnecessary
Break multi-step web missions into durable planned steps

example_uses: Search for official docs on X and open only useful results
Log into a site with credentials I provide, then check my dashboard
Find the best GitHub repo for Y, open it, and summarize the README
Browse a logged-in account and complete a multi-step settings change
